title: FEVM-Data-Dao
tagline: Data dao where members add data and gets rewards when their data is requested by a client
description: This project is semi-complete and doesn't function as described in the short description.The functionalities to be added are creating frontend,writing scripts for DataDao.sol and improve DataDao.sol code.Using mock storage for storing the data and Retrieve the data using berix Api .
how_its_made: This Project is made using Fevm hardkit as base,coded in solidity,javascript. Working on this hackathon improved our understanding on Fevm and Fvm and Filecoin ecosystem.Tried installing lotus lite  and running the daemon which we couldnt succeed due to storage compliance. We learned a lot why we should use Filecoin.And will continue to hack filecoin.
